name: WWE (TKO Group Holdings)
notes: Event-host shape: WWE stages premium live events plus weekly Raw/SmackDown TV; the 2026 Saudi calendar is three events (Royal Rumble 31 Jan, Night of Champions 27 Jun, Crown Jewel 7 Nov) plus WrestleMania 43 in Riyadh in 2027. No event entity exists in the schema yet, so events are recorded on the matching issue (Beyond-The-Jersey/data) as unsourced facts, not as clubs.

Saudi partnership origin: announced 1 Mar 2018 as a 10-year strategic multiplatform partnership with the Saudi General Sports Authority in support of Vision 2030, beginning with the Greatest Royal Rumble (27 Apr 2018, King Abdullah Sports City, Jeddah).

GEA expansion: on 4 Nov 2019 WWE and the Saudi General Entertainment Authority expanded their live event partnership through 2027 to include a second annual large-scale event; Riyadh Season (the GEA's annual festival, launched Oct 2019) hosts the annual Crown Jewel event.

2026 events are GEA/Riyadh Season productions: the Crown Jewel 2026 announcement (1 Sep 2026) comes 'from the General Entertainment Authority, on behalf of HE Turki Alalshikh, in partnership with WWE', and the Royal Rumble 2026 announcement (9 Dec 2025) is under the leadership of HE Turki Alalshikh with GEA and Riyadh Season.

WWE is part of TKO Group Holdings (NYSE: TKO), a controlled company: its FY2024 10-K states Endeavor subsidiaries held about 53.9% of voting interests, and after Silver Lake's take-private of Endeavor (completed 24 Mar 2025) Endeavor retains its controlling stake in TKO.
Crown Jewel 2026 is at 'Riyadh Season Stadium at KAFD' - the venue name itself carries the host's brand.
